name: Elin Voss
speed: 30 ft. while ogre gauntlets meet armor Strength requirement
proficiencies: All armor, shields, simple/martial weapons. Sage: Arcana/History; Cleric: Insight/Medicine; lineage skill: Perception.
bio:
An investigator who catalogs magical disasters and hunts the people exploiting them. Elin distrusts unchecked power but judges spellcasters by their actions. Bond: finish a dead colleague's investigation. Flaw: struggles to stop working when a mystery puts someone in danger.

Enter 12 gp. Apply War Caster concentration advantage manually. Spell DC 18 and AC 19 are included. Rebuke Invoker has an omitted DC in the source: default recommendation DC 16 is a declared table assumption, not printed rules. Track five Witch Hunter strikes, five Rebukes and the shared Channel Divinity pool.

Remaining gold: 12 gp. See the build guide for native scores, sources, spending and conditional features.

traits.name: Build audit
traits.description: Custom Lineage +2 Wis; racial Fey Touched +1 Wis; Cleric 4 +2 Wis. Gauntlets replace native Str 8 with 19. Standard-array Str/Dex/Con/Int/Wis/Cha: 8/13/14/12/15/10. Native: 8/13/14/12/20/10. Equipped: 19/13/14/12/20/10. Average HP 52 at level 7.

traits.name: Campaign constraints
traits.description: War Caster is the original 2014 house-rule feat and gives no ability-score increase. Sage (PHB) grants no feat. Other feat/stat increases have their separate sources recorded. One Rare and one Uncommon item, no Renaissance/Futuristic equipment. Additional 638 gp plus background 10 gp; spent 636, remaining 12. No gear resale, free summoned creatures, pre-cast buffs or paid extra spells assumed.

traits.name: Lineage and feat sources
traits.description: Lineage +2 Wisdom; racial Fey Touched +1 Wisdom, choosing Misty Step and Dissonant Whispers. Cleric 4 +2 Wisdom. House feat War Caster has no stat increase. Variable Trait grants Perception, not darkvision.

traits.name: War Caster
traits.description: Advantage on Constitution saves to maintain spell concentration when damage is taken. Somatic components can be performed with weapons/shield held. Can replace a provoked opportunity attack with a one-action spell targeting only that creature. Does not waive priced/consumed material handling.

traits.name: Fey Touched
traits.description: Misty Step and Dissonant Whispers each have one free cast per long rest and can also use slots. Wisdom is their ability; the amulet applies to the save DC of these spells. These are separate from the 12 cleric preparations.

traits.name: Inquisition armor and weapons
traits.description: The Player Pack subclass grants martial weapons and heavy armor at Cleric 1. Gauntlets set native Strength 8 to 19, meeting splint's requirement; without them reduce Strength and walking speed appropriately.

traits.name: Witch Hunter's Strike
traits.description: On a weapon hit, expend a use for +1d8 force, or +2d8 force if the target is concentrating on a spell. Five uses per long rest. If this damage causes a failed concentration save, gain temporary HP equal to the extra force dealt. This is not automatic extra damage on every hit.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Spell Shield
traits.description: Bonus action, visible target within 30 feet: 1d10+7 temporary HP, lasting up to an hour. While ANY of these particular temporary HP remain, target has resistance to spell damage and advantage on saves against spells. Losing/replacing them ends those riders. Different temporary-HP pools do not stack.

traits.name: Rebuke Invoker
traits.description: Reaction when a visible creature within 60 feet casts: Constitution save, taking 1d8 per level of slot expended +5 force on failure, half on success; cantrips count as level 1. Five uses per long rest. The available Player Pack entry omits the save DC: this build conservatively assumes feature DC 16 (8+PB+Wis), pending the GM's ruling. Do not automatically add the amulet's spell-only DC bonus. This feature does not automatically counter the spell.

traits.name: Channel Divinity and Harness Divine Power
traits.description: Two shared Channel Divinity uses per short/long rest; amulet grants one additional activation per dawn without spending a use. Turn Undead/Destroy Undead CR 1/2 follow the 2014 rules. Optional Tasha Harness Divine Power: bonus action, spend a use to regain an expended 1st/2nd-level slot, at most twice per long rest.

traits.name: Casting totals and hands
traits.description: Wisdom 20 plus +2 amulet: spell DC 18, spell attacks +10. No item bonus to damage/healing or Dispel Magic checks. War Caster handles somatic components with shield/weapon; stow the weapon to handle a pearl or consumed diamond. No extra attack or Divine Strike at Cleric 7.

traits.name: Equipment attunement
traits.description: Amulet and gauntlets require attunement, two of three slots used. Both bonuses are already included in the snapshot. Native Strength without the gauntlets is 8.

traits.name: Researcher
traits.description: Sage background: when you do not know a piece of lore, you often know which person or source might provide it. Access may still require travel, negotiation or a dangerous expedition. No feat or ability increase.

attacks.name: Warhammer + Witch Hunter's Strike
attacks.description: Costs one of five uses; use the other row if the target is concentrating.

attacks.name: Warhammer + concentrating-target Strike
attacks.description: Costs one use and requires target concentration.

attacks.name: Spiritual Weapon
attacks.range: Created within 60 ft.; attacks within 5 ft.
attacks.description: Bonus-action spell attack, only while the 2014 spell is active.

equipment.name: +2 Amulet of the Devout
equipment.description: Rare allocation; attuned. Spell DC/attack +2 included.

equipment.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
equipment.description: Uncommon allocation; attuned. Strength set to 19.

equipment.name: Warhammer
equipment.description: Free Cleric starting weapon, martial proficiency from Inquisition.

equipment.name: Chain Mail
equipment.description: Free starting armor, spare NOT worn.

equipment.name: Light Crossbow
equipment.description: Free starting weapon; two hands required.

equipment.name: Crossbow Bolts (20)
equipment.description: Free starting ammunition.

equipment.name: Shield
equipment.description: Free starting equipment; wielded.

equipment.name: Amulet
equipment.description: Free mundane holy symbol, backup focus.

equipment.name: Explorer's Pack
equipment.description: Free pack; contents included in weight.

equipment.name: Sage equipment
equipment.description: Ink, quill, knife, colleague letter, common clothes, pouch. Background 10 gp included in total.

equipment.name: Splint Armor
equipment.description: Purchased for 200 gp each (200 gp total). Worn. Gauntlets meet Strength requirement.

equipment.name: Diamond worth 300 gp
equipment.description: Purchased for 300 gp each (300 gp total). Consumed by one Revivify; listed spell component.

equipment.name: Pearl worth 100 gp
equipment.description: Purchased for 100 gp each (100 gp total). Reusable Identify component.

equipment.name: Holy Water (flask)
equipment.description: Purchased for 25 gp each (25 gp total).

equipment.name: Healer's Kit
equipment.description: Purchased for 5 gp each (5 gp total).

equipment.name: Crowbar
equipment.description: Purchased for 2 gp each (2 gp total).

equipment.name: Manacles
equipment.description: Purchased for 2 gp each (2 gp total).

equipment.name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
equipment.description: Purchased for 1 gp each (1 gp total).

equipment.name: Ball Bearings (bag of 1,000)
equipment.description: Purchased for 1 gp each (1 gp total).

equipment.name: Gold coins
equipment.description: 12 gp remain. Set the gold counter; this row records the same money, not extra.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: Touch a willing creature; add 1d4 to one ability check before the duration ends. Concentration: do not cast while preserving another concentration spell.

spells.name: Toll the Dead
spells.description: Wisdom save DC 18; on failure 2d8 necrotic, or 2d12 if the target is missing any hit points. No damage on success.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.description: Dexterity save DC 18; 2d8 radiant on a failure, none on success. The target gains no benefit from cover for this save.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.description: Create a harmless supernatural sign: a booming voice, flickering flames, tremors, brief sound, opening an unlocked door, or altered eye appearance. Up to three minute-long effects can coexist.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: Up to three targets add 1d4 to attacks and saves. Concentration; +1 target per slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: Bonus action; restore 1d4+5 HP to a visible creature, except undead/constructs. +1d4 per slot level above 1st. The 2014 bonus-action spell restriction applies.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.description: Protect a willing creature against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead. Those creatures attack it with disadvantage and cannot charm, frighten or possess it. Concentration. Consumes holy water or powdered silver and iron; a focus cannot replace consumed material.
spells.materials: holy water or powdered silver and iron, which the spell consumes

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.description: A hostile targeted attack or harmful targeted spell against the warded creature requires a Wisdom save DC 18. It does not block areas. Ends if the warded creature attacks, casts a spell affecting an enemy, or deals damage, including ongoing Spirit Guardians damage.

spells.name: Command
spells.description: Wisdom save DC 18; a creature understanding your language obeys a one-word command as specified by the full spell. No effect on undead or a directly harmful command. No concentration.

spells.name: Aid
spells.description: Three targets gain 5 current and maximum HP for 8 hours, plus 5 per slot level above 2nd. Not temporary HP and no concentration. Not applied to the starting sheet.
spells.materials: a tiny strip of white cloth

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.description: Touch a creature and end one disease or one instance of blindness, deafness, paralysis or poisoning.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.description: 2014 version: NO concentration. Bonus-action melee spell attack at +10, dealing 1d8+5 force. Later bonus actions move the weapon up to 20 feet and attack within 5 feet of it. A 4th-level slot deals 2d8+5. Magic-item bonuses to hit do not add damage.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.description: 2014 version. Exclude visible allies when cast. In the 15-foot area, affected creatures have halved speed. First entry on a turn or starting a turn there requires a Wisdom save DC 18: 3d8 radiant on failure, half on success, with +1d8 per higher slot. Moving the aura over a creature does not itself trigger damage. Concentration.

spells.name: Revivify
spells.description: Touch a creature dead no longer than 1 minute; return it with 1 HP. Cannot reverse old-age death or restore missing parts. Consumes diamonds worth 300 gp; one diamond is carried.
spells.materials: diamonds worth 300 gp, which the spell consumes

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.description: The first damage that would drop the target to 0 HP leaves it at 1 instead, ending the spell. Alternatively negates one instant-death effect that deals no damage. No concentration.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.description: Target ignores difficult terrain and magical speed reduction, paralysis and restraint. Spend 5 feet of movement to escape nonmagical restraints or grapples. Underwater movement/attacks avoid their normal penalties. No concentration.
spells.materials: a leather strap, bound around the arm or a similar appendage

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: Sense nearby magic, then use an action to examine a visible aura and learn its school if any. Concentration and normal barrier limits. Ritual if your class permits.

spells.name: Identify
spells.description: Learn properties and use of a touched magic item or which spells affect a touched creature. Requires a reusable pearl worth 100 gp; a focus cannot replace that cost. Does not automatically reveal every curse. Ritual if your class permits.
spells.materials: a pearl worth at least 100 gp and an owl feather

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.description: See invisible creatures/objects as visible and see into the Ethereal Plane to 60 feet. No concentration.
spells.materials: a pinch of talc and a small sprinkling of powdered silver

spells.name: Silence
spells.description: 20-foot-radius sphere blocks sound. Creatures entirely inside are deafened and immune to thunder; verbal-component spells cannot be cast there. Concentration.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.description: Automatically end spells no higher than the slot used (at least level 3). Higher-level spells require an ability check at +5, DC 10 + spell level. A spell DC/attack item bonus does not improve this check.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.description: Touch a creature/object to end curses within the spell's scope. For a cursed magic item, break its owner's attunement; the spell does not necessarily remove the item's curse.

spells.name: Arcane Eye
spells.description: Create an invisible magical sensor, initially within 30 feet. As an action move it up to 30 feet; it can pass a 1-inch opening. Concentration, sight with 30-foot darkvision, no hearing.

spells.name: Locate Creature
spells.description: Sense the direction of a described/named familiar creature within 1,000 feet, subject to familiarity, form and running-water restrictions. Concentration.
spells.materials: a bit of fur from a bloodhound

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Fey Touched spell: bonus-action teleport up to 30 feet to a visible unoccupied space. One free cast per long rest or use slots. Separate from normal preparation limits.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.description: Fey Touched choice: Wisdom save DC 18; 3d6 psychic and immediate movement away using the target's reaction on failure; half damage with no movement on success. This reaction movement can provoke opportunity attacks. One free cast per long rest or use slots.
